tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find Superzoo products in Slovakia, with public online EUR offers and availability summaries. Default 10, max 50 results. Search checks up to 200 mixed candidates; upstream totals are not product counts. Optional brand and inclusive decimal price filters apply within this bounded window; omitted candidates may contain matches. online_only requires explicit delivery availability. Conditional offers remain conditional. Partial detail failures are marked on each product. Use variant-specific product IDs for stock lookups.

brand.description: Exact brand name, ignoring case and accents.

min_price.description: Inclusive minimum public offer price. Conditional offers retain their eligibility labels.

max_price.description: Inclusive maximum public offer price. Conditional offers retain their eligibility labels.

online_only.description: Include only explicit delivery availability; unknown status is omitted. No address or timing guarantee.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get product details, variants, public online EUR offers in Slovakia, delivery availability and available-store count. Price variant identifies conditional offers such as familyPrice; membership eligibility and branch prices are not verified.

tools.name: get_product_availability
tools.description: Get availability in Slovakia stores for one product variant. Optional city filters store name/address locally, ignoring accents. Stock status and pickup text are separate. No exact quantities or branch prices. Check checked_at for freshness.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare one to ten unique product variants in Slovakia, preserving input order and conditional EUR offers. Partial failures remain explicit. Product checked_at values retain their original retrieval times.

tools.name: find_common_stores
tools.description: Find stores for one to ten unique product variants in Slovakia, optionally filtered by city. all_in_stock requires explicit inStock for every requested product. Missing observations and failures remain unknown. Pickup text is separate from stock; quantities and branch prices are unknown.
